ownership_rationale: shadcn owns adding official registry components to the configured app while safely preserving its existing local variants.
pencil-dev owns creating and connecting components in the open Pencil document and exporting the requested PNG through Pencil MCP.
frontend-design owns the dashboard's art direction, typography, and visual hierarchy as a design strategy deliverable without implementation.
react-components-engineer owns reusable component runtime behavior, including listener cleanup and forwarded ref correctness, independently of any UI library.
react-spa-engineer owns integrating form validation, pending state, and retry behavior with the React SPA's runtime and server state.
web-ui-reviewer owns the requested read-only UX and accessibility audit and its evidence-scoped findings.
agent-browser owns opening the rendered website, submitting its form, and verifying the visible terminal result.

necessary_handoffs.purpose: Translate the Pencil design into the implemented web interface while preserving its visual hierarchy and existing UI system.
Implement the screen using the project's configured shadcn components and conventions.
Verify the implemented screen and requested visible behavior in the browser.

ownership_rationale: pencil-dev owns the initial Pencil screen design, frontend-design carries the design into web code, shadcn owns its component integration, and agent-browser supplies rendered verification.
